title: Typed or picked
text: Type the date into segments or choose it from a calendar popup.

title: Business calendar
text: Weekends and holidays are marked and can be made unselectable.

title: Disabled dates
text: Minimum and maximum dates plus a function to block any other day.

title: Locale aware
text: Month names, week start, and segment order follow the locale.

title: Form ready
text: Validation, custom errors, and native form submission.
